pages.description: Shop Peg Perego Taurus Electric Ride On with Winch at Clarkes of Cavan. A kids' electric off-road ride-on. Available online in Ireland.
pages.ld_description:
The 2-seater utility truck can tackle even the most extreme off-road driving! With its impressive design, the top-of-the-range Taurus utility truck is truly indefatigable! This robust truck with a 12V/12Ah/150Wh rechargeable battery can tackle the most extreme adventures, even with two passengers! Exceptional performance is guaranteed by the powerful 350W motor and 2-wheel drive, allowing the truck to easily tackle slopes of up to 17%. Age: 3 to 5 years.

Large seat, adjustable
Adjustable in four positions to suit drivers of all sizes. Two armrests for comfortable, safe driving also act as handles for hanging on when travelling over rough terrain.

Sculpted tread tyres
With great traction for perfect adherence to the ground. An electric truck that can easily travel up slopes of up to 17%.

Big tipping box
The load box, which can carry up to 10 kg, has a side opening and handles for easy unloading even while sitting comfortably.

Two forward gears and reverse gear
The second gear has a lock that, when necessary, prevents an inexperienced child from using it.

Accelerator and brake in a single pedal
The accelerator pedal, when released, becomes a brake that automatically stops the toy.

Manually operated winch
Prolong the fun by inventing new games.

Lights and sounds like a real utility truck
